FN-QN73L41-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 407
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/17/2025
House Bill 407 as introduced could increase potential tax receipts to local redevelopment
authorities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: (1) the amount of
payments of in lieu of taxes for transient occupancy tax collected by a local redevelopment
authority under the provisions of this bill; and (2) the amount of transient occupancy tax
otherwise collected by the respective taxing authorities under current law.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of
Revenue to compile and publish annual summaries regarding payments in lieu of taxes to local
redevelopment authorities on the department's website.
